entries.game_character_passivedescription_karma: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.
entries.game_spell_kayn_q_main_0:
Kayn dashes then spins his scythe, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to enemies he passes through, then deals the damage again to nearby enemies.

Darkin Slayer: Instead deal @DarkinFlatDamage@ plus @DarkinPercentDamage@ max Health physical damage.
entries.game_spell_kayn_q_main_1: Kayn dashes then spins his scythe, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to enemies he passes through, then deals the damage again to nearby enemies.
entries.game_spell_kayn_q_main_2:
Kayn dashes then spins his scythe, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to enemies he passes through, then deals the damage again to nearby enemies.

Darkin Slayer: Instead deal @DarkinFlatDamage@ plus @DarkinPercentDamage@ max Health physical damage.
entries.game_spell_kayn_w_maintext_0:
Kayn swipes his scythe upward, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and Slowing enemies hit by @Effect3Amount*-100@%, decaying over @Effect5Amount@ seconds.

Shadow Assassin: Kayn can move while using this Ability and increases its range.

Darkin Slayer: Additionally Knocks Up enemies hit for @Effect2Amount@ second.
entries.game_spell_kayn_w_maintext_1:
Kayn swipes his scythe upward, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and Slowing enemies hit by @Effect3Amount*-100@%, decaying over @Effect5Amount@ seconds.

Shadow Assassin: Kayn can move while using this Ability and increases its range.
entries.game_spell_kayn_w_maintext_2:
Kayn swipes his scythe upward, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and Slowing enemies hit by @Effect3Amount*-100@%, decaying over @Effect5Amount@ seconds.

Darkin Slayer: Additionally Knocks Up enemies hit for @Effect2Amount@ second.
entries.passive_masteryipassive_tooltip: Every @AttackCount@th Attack, Master Yi strikes twice. The second Attack deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.
entries.reminder_camouflage: <keywordStealth>Camouflaged</keywordStealth> units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.
entries.reminder_ghosted: Ghosted units can pass through other units.
entries.reminder_invisibility: <keywordStealth>Invisible</keywordStealth> units cannot be revealed except by turrets or <font color='#ee91d7'>True Sight</font color>.
entries.reminder_untargetable: Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.
entries.spell_alistare_summary: Alistar tramples nearby enemy units, ignoring unit collision and gaining stacks if he damages an enemy champion. At full stacks Alistar's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals additional magic damage and stuns them.
entries.spell_alistare_tooltip:
Alistar begins trampling the ground, becoming Ghosted and dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @Duration@ seconds to nearby enemies. Each pulse that damages a champion grants a stack.

At @MaxStacks@ stacks, Alistar's next Attack against champions Stuns for @StunDuration@ second and deals an additional @AttackBonusDamage@ magic damage.
entries.spell_alistare_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.</rules>
entries.spell_alistarpassive_summary: Alistar charges his roar by stunning or displacing enemy champions or when nearby enemies die. When fully charged he heals himself all nearby allied champions.
entries.spell_alistarpassive_tooltip:
Alistar gains a stack whenever he Stuns or Knocks an enemy champion, or whenever an enemy dies. At @PassiveMaxStacks@ stacks, Alistar roars, restoring @BaseHeal@ Health to himself and @AllyHeal@ Health to nearby allied champions.

Enemy champion and epic jungle monster deaths fully charge this Ability.
entries.spell_alphastrike_summary: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.
entries.spell_alphastrike_tooltip:
Master Yi becomes Untargetable and teleports to rapidly strike enemies near his target, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to all enemies hit after @AlphaStrikeBounces@ hits.

This Ability can strike the same enemy repeatedly if there are no other targets, dealing @SubsequentHitMultiplier*100@% damage for subsequent hits (@SubesquentDamage@), for a maximum single target total of @SingleTotalDamage@ physical damage.
entries.spell_alphastrike_tooltipextendedbelowli:
Applies %i:OnHit% On-Hit effects at @BaseOnHitMultiplier*100@% damage. Subsequent hits are reduced to @SubsequentHitMultiplier*100@% of this.
Can critically strike for an additional @CritBonus@ physical damage. Subsequent hits are reduced to @SubsequentHitMultiplier*100@% of this, for a maximum single target total of @SingleCritTotalDamage@.
Jungle monsters take @BonusMonsterDamage@ bonus damage per strike.
Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @BasicAttackCDR@ second.
{{ Spell_AlphaStrike_Name }} does not reduce its own cooldown or stack {{ Passive_MasterYiPassive_Name }} %i:OnHit% On-Hit.
Master Yi will reappear near the initial target.
entries.spell_alphastrike_tooltipsimple:
Become untargetable and teleport to the targeted enemy, dealing damage to it and enemies nearby.

Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Alpha Strike.
entries.spell_carpetbomb_summary: Corki flies a short distance, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that damages opponents who remain in it.
entries.spell_carpetbomb_tooltip: Corki flies over and scorches a path, burning it for @TrailDuration@ seconds. Enemies in the fire take up to <magicDamage>@MaximumDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over the duration.
entries.spell_ferocioushowl_summary: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.
entries.spell_ferocioushowl_tooltip: Alistar immediately cleanses all <status>Disabling</status> effects and takes @RDamageReduction@% reduced damage for @RDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_ggun_summary: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.
entries.spell_ggun_tooltip: Corki fires a gatling gun in front of him, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> over @SprayDuration@ seconds and shredding up to <scaleArmor>@ShredMax*-1@ Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.
entries.spell_ggun_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>The shred lingers for @ShredDuration@ seconds after being hit.</rules>
entries.spell_headbutt_summary: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.
entries.spell_headbutt_tooltip: Alistar rams into an enemy, <status>Knocking</status> them <status>Back</status> and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_highlander_summary: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.
entries.spell_highlander_tooltip:
Passive: Champion takedowns reduce the remaining Cooldown of Master Yi's basic Abilities by @RCooldownRefund*100@%.

Active: Master Yi enters a trance, gaining @RMSBonus@% Move Speed, @RASBonus@% Attack Speed, and immunity to Slows for @RDuration@ seconds. Champion takedowns extend the duration of this Ability by @RKillAssistExtension@ seconds.
entries.spell_highlander_tooltipextendedbelowlin: <rules>The duration of <spellName>{{ Spell_Highlander_Name }}</spellName> is paused during <spellName>{{ Spell_AlphaStrike_Name }}</spellName> and <spellName>{{ Spell_Meditate_Name }}</spellName></rules>
entries.spell_highlander_tooltipsimple:
Passive: Champion takedowns reduce the Cooldown of Master Yi's basic abilities.

Active: Grants Move Speed, Attack Speed, and immunity to slows for @RDuration@ seconds.

While active, champion takedowns extend the duration of Highlander by @RKillAssistExtension@ seconds.
entries.spell_karmae_tooltip_0: Karma grants an allied champion <shield>@TotalShield@ Shield</shield> for @ShieldDuration@s and <speed>@MoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed</speed> for @MoveSpeedDuration@s.
entries.spell_karmae_tooltip_1: <spellName>Mantra:</spellName> Karma focuses her power, granting an allied champion an additional <shield>@spell.KarmaMantra:REBonusShield@ Shield</shield>. The shield's power spills over, granting <shield>@spell.KarmaMantra:REBonusShieldArea@ Shield</shield> and <speed>@spell.KarmaMantra:REMoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed</speed> to nearby champions.
entries.spell_karmamantra_summary: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.
entries.spell_karmamantra_tooltip:
Karma empowers her next Ability used within 8 seconds.
  • {{Spell_KarmaQ_Name}}: Deals an additional @RQImpactDamage@ magic damage and leaves behind a circle of flame, Slowing enemies and dealing an additional @RQFieldDamage@ magic damage.
  • {{Spell_KarmaSpiritBind_Name}}: Karma will restore @RWHealAmount@ missing Health at the beginning and end of the tether, and Root for @RWBonusRoot@s longer.
  • {{Spell_KarmaSolKimShield_Name}}: Karma shields her target for @REBonusShield@ more Shield, and also shields allies near her target, granting them @REBonusShieldArea@ Shield and @REMoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed.
entries.spell_karmapassive_tooltip:
Karma begins the game with a point in {{Spell_KarmaMantra_Name}}.

She reduces the Cooldown of {{Spell_KarmaMantra_Name}} by @SpellMantraRefund@ seconds when she damages a champion with an Ability.
entries.spell_karmaq_summary:
Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit.

Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.
entries.spell_karmaq_tooltip_0: Karma fires a blast of energy, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the first target hit and surrounding enemies, and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowAmount*-100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_karmaq_tooltip_1: <spellName>Mantra:</spellName> Karma unleashes a devastating blast, dealing an additional <magicDamage>@spell.KarmaMantra:RQImpactDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the first target hit and surrounding enemies. The blast leaves a field for @spell.KarmaMantra:RQSlowDuration@s, <status>Slowing</status> by @spell.KarmaMantra:RQSlow*-100@%, after which it explodes, dealing <magicDamage>@spell.KarmaMantra:RQFieldDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_karmasolkimshield_summary:
Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally.

Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.
entries.spell_karmaspiritbind_summary:
Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.

Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.
entries.spell_karmaw_tooltip_0: Karma tethers herself to a champion or jungle monster, dealing <magicDamage>@InitialDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and revealing them for @TetherDuration@s. If the tether remains unbroken, the target takes <magicDamage>@InitialDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> again and is <status>Rooted</status> for @RootDuration@s.
entries.spell_karmaw_tooltip_1: <spellName>Mantra:</spellName> Karma creates an empowered tether, restoring <healing>@spell.KarmaMantra:RWHealAmount@ missing Health</healing>, dealing <magicDamage>@InitialDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, and revealing them for @TetherDuration@s. If the tether remains unbroken, Karma restores <healing>@spell.KarmaMantra:RWHealAmount@ missing Health</healing> again, <status>Roots</status> for an additional @spell.KarmaMantra:RWBonusRoot@s, and deals another <magicDamage>@InitialDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_katarinaewrapper_summary: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.
entries.spell_katarinaewrapper_tooltip:
Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger. If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for @TotalDamage@ magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range.

Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @DaggerCooldownReduction@ seconds (@TooltipDaggerReduction@). Katarina can blink to any location near the target.
entries.spell_katarinapassive_summary:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.
entries.spell_katarinapassive_tooltip:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged in the last @ResetWindow@ seconds, her Ability Cooldowns are reduced by @ResetCDR@ seconds.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.
entries.spell_katarinapassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_KatarinaPassive_Tooltip}}

Dagger slashes apply On-Hit Effects to champions.
entries.spell_katarinaq_summary: Katarina throws a <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.
entries.spell_katarinaq_tooltip: Katarina throws a <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor>, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the target and @MaxBounces@ nearby enemies. The <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor> then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.
entries.spell_katarinar_summary: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.
entries.spell_katarinar_tooltip:
Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals @DamageCalc@ magic damage and @ADDamageCalc@ physical damage, and applies @GrievousAmount*100@% Grievous Wounds for @GrievousDuration@ seconds.

Total over @Duration@ seconds to each enemy: @TotalDamageCalc@ magic damage and @TotalADDamageCalc@ physical damage.
entries.spell_katarinar_tooltipextendedbelowline:
This Ability applies %i:OnHit% On-Hit and On-Attack effects at @OnHitRatio*100@% damage, and does not Critically Strike or apply Life Steal.
The physical damage additionally increases with Attack Speed.
entries.spell_katarinaw_summary: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> into the air directly above herself.
entries.spell_katarinaw_tooltip: Katarina tosses a <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor> into the air and gains <speed>@MovespeedAmount@% Move Speed</speed> decaying over @MovespeedDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_kayne_tooltipextendedbelowline:
{{Reminder_Ghosted}}
Maximum duration in combat with enemy champions is @MaxInCombatTime@ seconds.
entries.spell_kaynpassive_summary:
Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin.

Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions.

Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.
entries.spell_kaynpassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_KaynPassive_Tooltip}}

@PassiveSecondFormDelayTooltip@ minutes after reaching full charge on either form, Kayn can transform into either, even if it is not at full charge. The timer is reduced by 5 seconds when gaining charge in the non-full form.
Kayn gains Homeguard after transforming.
entries.spell_kaynq_summary: Kayn dashes, then slashes. Both deal damage.
entries.spell_kaynq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Deals an additional <physicalDamage>@FlatBonusDmgToMonsters@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to minions and jungle monsters (max: @MaxDmgToMonsters@).</rules>
entries.spell_kaynr_summary: Kayn hides in an enemy's body, dealing massive damage when he bursts out.
entries.spell_kaynw_summary: Kayn damages and slows targets in a line.
entries.spell_khazixe_summary: Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Wings</font>, Leap's range increases and the cooldown resets on champion kill or assist.
entries.spell_khazixe_tooltip_0: Kha'Zix leaps, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> upon landing.
entries.spell_khazixe_tooltip_1: <evolve>Evolved Ability:</evolve> Kha'Zix leaps a further distance, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> upon landing. This Ability's Cooldown is refreshed on champion takedown.
entries.spell_khazixpassive_summary:
Nearby enemies that are Isolated from their allies are marked. Kha'Zix's abilities have interactions with Isolated targets.

When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, he gains Unseen Threat, causing his next basic attack against an enemy champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow them for a few seconds.
entries.spell_khazixpassive_tooltip:
When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, his next Attack against a champion deals an additional @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slows by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Enemies with no nearby allies become Isolated.
entries.spell_khazixq_summary: Deals physical damage to the target. Damage increased on <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Reaper Claws</font>, this refunds a percent of it's cooldown against <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets. Kha'Zix also gains increased range on his basic attacks and Taste Their Fear.
entries.spell_khazixq_tooltip_0: Kha'Zix slashes a nearby enemy, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.KhazixQ:BaseDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. This deals <physicalDamage>@spell.KhazixQ:IsoDamage@ damage</physicalDamage> instead to enemies <keywordMajor>Isolated</keywordMajor> from their allies.
entries.spell_khazixq_tooltip_1:
Evolved Ability - Passive: Kha'Zix increases the range of this Ability and his Attacks.

Evolved Ability - Active: Kha'zix slashes with improved claws, dealing @spell.KhazixQ:BaseDamage@ damage. Against Isolated targets, this deals @spell.KhazixQ:IsoDamage@ damage instead and reduces the Cooldown by @Effect4Amount@%.
entries.spell_khazixr_summary: Each rank allows Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities, giving it a unique additional effect. When activated, Kha'Zix becomes <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font>, triggering Unseen Threat and increasing Move Speed. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Adaptive Cloaking</font>, Void Assault gains increased <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisibility</font> duration, and an additional use.
entries.spell_khazixr_tooltip_0: <spellActive>Active:</spellActive> Kha'Zix becomes <keywordStealth>Invisible</keywordStealth> for @StealthDuration@ seconds and gains <speed>@BonusMovementSpeedPercent*100@% Move Speed</speed>. Kha'zix may <recast>Recast</recast> this Ability once within @RecastWindow@ seconds.
entries.spell_khazixr_tooltip_1: <evolve>Evolved Ability:</evolve> Kha'Zix becomes <keywordStealth>Invisible</keywordStealth> for an improved @EvolvedStealthDuration@ seconds and gains <speed>@BonusMovementSpeedPercent*100@% Move Speed</speed>. Kha'zix may <recast>Recast</recast> this Ability twice within 10 seconds.
entries.spell_khazixr_tooltip_p: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Leveling up this Ability allows Kha'zix to <evolve>Evolve</evolve> one of his Abilities, granting it additional effects.<li><spellName>{{Spell_KhazixQ_Name}}:</spellName> Gain Ability range, Attack range, and lowers Cooldown by @spell.KhazixQ:Effect4Amount@% against <keywordMajor>Isolated</keywordMajor> targets.<li><spellName>{{Spell_KhazixW_Name}}:</spellName> Fires 3 spikes and <status>Slows</status> by @spell.KhazixW:Effect3Amount@%, increased against <keywordMajor>Isolated</keywordMajor> targets.<li><spellName>{{Spell_KhazixE_Name}}:</spellName> Increased range and refreshes Cooldown on champion takedown.<li><spellName>{{Spell_KhazixR_Name}}:</spellName> <keywordStealth>Invisibility</keywordStealth> duration lasts @EvolvedStealthDuration@ seconds and gains second <recast>Recast</recast>.
entries.spell_khazixw_summary: Kha'Zix fires exploding spikes that deal physical damage to enemies hit. Kha'Zix is healed if he is also within the explosion radius. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Spike Racks</font>, Void Spike now fires three spikes in a cone, slow enemies hit, and reveals enemy champions hit for 2 seconds. <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets are slowed for extra.
entries.spell_khazixw_tooltip_0: Kha'Zix fires a spike dealing <physicalDamage>@BaseDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hit in a small area. If Kha'Zix is inside the area, he restores <healing>@HealAmount@ Health</healing>
entries.spell_khazixw_tooltip_1: <evolve>Evolved Ability:</evolve> Kha'Zix fires 3 spikes, each dealing <physicalDamage>@BaseDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first target hit in an area and revealing and <status>Slowing</status> by @Effect3Amount@% for @Effect4Amount@ seconds. Kha'Zix restores <healing>@HealAmount@ Health</healing> if he is within the blast. <keywordMajor>Isolated</keywordMajor> enemies are <status>Slowed</status> by @Effect7Amount@% instead.
entries.spell_manabarriericon_summary: Blitzcrank gains a shield based on their mana when dropping to low health.
entries.spell_manabarriericon_tooltip: When Blitzcrank falls below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health, they gain <shield>@ShieldAmount@ Shield</shield> for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_maokaie_summary: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.
entries.spell_maokaie_tooltip:
Maokai flings a sapling, which stands watch for @SaplingDuration@ seconds. Saplings chase nearby enemies, detonating on arrival to deal @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slow surrounding enemies by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. Sap Magic's Cooldown is reduced by an additional 4 seconds if the sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster.

If placed in brush, Saplings instead last for @EmpoweredSaplingDuration@ seconds and cause a larger explosion, dealing @TotalEmpoweredDamage@ magic damage over @EmpoweredDoTDuration@ seconds and Slowing enemies by @EmpoweredSlowAmount@.
entries.spell_maokaie_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Saplings run at @SaplingMoveSpeed@ Move Speed. Brush saplings do not deal the increased damage to minions.</rules>
entries.spell_maokaipassive_summary: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.
entries.spell_maokaipassive_tooltip:
Maokai's next Attack restores @PassiveHealingTotal@ Health.

Using an Ability or being hit by an enemy champion's Ability reduces the Cooldown by @PassiveCooldownReduction@ seconds. Being hit by large or epic monster's Attacks or Abilities reduces the Cooldown by @JungPassCooldownReduction@ second.
entries.spell_maokaiq_summary: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.
entries.spell_maokaiq_tooltip: Maokai smashes his fist into the ground, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ plus @BasePercentHealth*100@% max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and briefly <status>Slowing</status>. Nearby enemies are also <status>Knocked Back</status>.
entries.spell_maokaiq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>This Ability deals an additional <magicDamage>@BonusMonsterDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to jungle monsters.</rules>
entries.spell_maokair_summary: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.
entries.spell_maokair_tooltip: Maokai summons a colossal wave of brambles and thorns, <status>Rooting</status> enemies for @MinRootDuration@ to @MaxRootDuration@ seconds, increasing with distance travelled, and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Hitting a champion gives Maokai <speed>@MoveHaste*100@% Move Speed</speed>, decaying over @HasteDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_maokaiw_summary: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.
entries.spell_maokaiw_tooltip: Maokai transforms into a moving mass of roots, becoming Untargetable and dashing to an enemy. Upon arrival, he <status>Roots</status> the enemy for @RootDuration@ second(s) and deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_masteryipassive_summary: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.
entries.spell_masteryipassive_tooltipextended:
{{Passive_MasterYiPassive_Tooltip}}

The second strike counts as a normal Attack; it is able to critically strike and applies on-hit effects.
entries.spell_meditate_summary: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.
entries.spell_meditate_tooltip:
Master Yi channels, restoring @TotalHeal@ Health over @HealDuration@ seconds. This healing is increased by up to @MaxMissingHealthPercent*100@% based on Master Yi's missing Health.

While channeling and for @DRLinger@ seconds afterwards, he takes @InitialDR@ reduced damage, decreased to @DamageReduction*100@% after the first @InitialExtraDRDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_meditate_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike.
Damage reduction is halved against turrets.
entries.spell_meditate_tooltipsimple:
Channel to reduce incoming damage and restore health over @HealDuration@ seconds.

Attempting to move or attack will end the channel.
entries.spell_missilebarrage_summary: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every 3rd missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.
entries.spell_missilebarrage_tooltip:
Corki fires a missile that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @RSmallMissileDamage@ physical damage to surrounding enemies. Every third missile instead deals @RBigMissileDamage@ physical damage.

This Ability has up to @MaxAmmoTOOLTIP@ charges. Basic attacks against champions reduce the time between charges by @AttackRefund@ seconds on hit.
entries.spell_nilahe_summary: Nilah enthusiastically dashes toward her target, dealing damage to any enemies she passes through on the way.
entries.spell_nilahe_tooltip: Nilah dashes through a unit, dealing <physicalDamage>@DashDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to any enemies she passes through.
entries.spell_nilahpassive_summary: Nilah gains increased experience from last-hitting minions along with the ability to enhance and share nearby healing and shielding from her allies.
entries.spell_nilahpassive_tooltip:
When Nilah kills a minion, she and her nearest ally gain @ExperiencePercentage*100@% of the experience they would have normally lost from sharing the kill.

Nilah gains @HealingIncrease*100@% increased effectiveness from healing and @ShieldIncrease*100@% from shielding given to her by allied champions abilities. If an ally heals or shields her, they will also gain the increased amount of the shield or heal themselves. If an ally shields or heals themself, Nilah will also gain that additional effect.
entries.spell_nilahpassive_tooltipextended:
When Nilah kills a minion, she and her nearest ally gain @ExperiencePercentage*100@% of the experience they would have normally lost from sharing the kill.

Nilah gains @HealingIncrease*100@% increased effectiveness from healing and @ShieldIncrease*100@% from shielding given to her by allied champions abilities. If an ally heals or shields her, they will also gain the increased amount of the shield or heal themselves. If an ally shields or heals themself, Nilah will also gain that additional effect.

Shields shared by Nilah have a maximum duration of @ShieldMaxDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_nilahq_summary: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration.
entries.spell_nilahq_tooltip:
Passive: Nilah gains @CritArmorPen@ Armor Penetration, and her Attacks against champions restore @CritLifesteal@ damage dealt as Health. Overhealing from this is converted into a Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

Active: Nilah cracks her whip-blade, dealing @DamageCalc@ physical damage. If an enemy unit or structure is hit, Nilah gains 125 Attack Range and @BonusAttackSpeedCalc@% Attack Speed, and her Attacks hit in a cone for @BuffDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_nilahq_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Damage is increased by her Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at @ActiveCritScaling*100@% effectiveness.
If cast during Slipstream, Nilah creates a wave of water striking all enemies along Nilah's path.
Area attacks deal @MinionMod*100@% damage to minions and @MonsterMod*100@% damage to monsters.
This ability executes low Health minions.
entries.spell_nilahr_summary: Twirling her whip-blade in joyful exuberance, Nilah deals damage to enemies around her before pulling them closer with her weapon.
entries.spell_nilahr_tooltip:
Nilah whirls her whip-blade, dealing @DamagePerTickCalcTooltip@ physical damage over 1 second, then finishes with a burst of @DamageCalc@ physical damage that also Pulls nearby enemies toward her.

Apotheosis heals Nilah and her nearby allies for @ChampHealingPercent@ (+@spell.NilahQ:CritLifesteal@ {{ Spell_NilahQ_Name }}) of the damage dealt to enemy champions, converting any overhealing into a Shield for @Duration@ seconds.
entries.spell_nilahw_summary: Nilah envelops herself in mist, increasing her movement speed and allowing her to gracefully dodge all incoming attacks. Any allies she touches during the mist's duration will also gain this effect.
entries.spell_nilahw_tooltip:
Nilah envelops herself in mist for @BaseDuration@ seconds, becoming Ghosted, gaining @MoveSpeedPercent*100@% Move Speed, dodging Attacks, and reducing magic damage taken by @MagicDamageReduction*100@%.

While active, touching allied champions envelops them in mist, granting the same benefits for @ShareBaseDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_nocturnee_summary: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.
entries.spell_nocturnee_tooltip:
Passive: Nocturne gains @TooltipFearMS*100@% Move Speed toward Feared enemies.

Active: Nocturne plants a nightmare tether into his target, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @LeashDuration@ seconds. If the tether remains unbroken, the target is Feared for @CCDuration@ second(s).
entries.spell_nocturnee_tooltipsimple:
Passive: Gain massively increased Move Speed toward feared enemies.

Active: Damages an enemy over @LeashDuration@ second(s). If this completes, the target is feared for @CCDuration@ second(s).
entries.spell_nocturnep_summary:
Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself.

Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.
entries.spell_nocturnep_tooltip:
Every @Cooldown@ seconds, Nocturne's next Attack strikes all nearby enemies for @TotalDamageNoCrit@ physical damage and restores @TotalHealing@ Health per target hit.

Nocturne's Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @AACDR@ second, increased to @AAChampMonsterCDR@ against champions and jungle monsters.
entries.spell_nocturnep_tooltipextended:
Every @Cooldown@ seconds, Nocturne's next Attack strikes all nearby enemies for @TotalDamageNoCrit@ physical damage and restores @TotalHealing@ Health per target hit.

Nocturne's Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @AACDR@ second, increased to @AAChampMonsterCDR@ against champions and jungle monsters.

Umbra Blades deals @DamageMinionMod*100@% less damage to minions and heals @HealMinionMod*100@% less from lane minions.
entries.spell_nocturneq_summary: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
entries.spell_nocturneq_tooltip:
Nocturne throws a shadow blade, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and leaving a dusk trail for @TrailDuration@ seconds. Enemy champions hit also leave a trail.

While on the trail, Nocturne is Ghosted and gains @MoveSpeed@% Move Speed and @BonusTrailAD@ Attack Damage.
entries.spell_nocturneq_tooltipsimple:
Throws a shadow blade, damaging enemeis struck and leaving a Dusk Trail.

Nocturne gains @MoveSpeed@% Move Speed and @BonusTrailAD@ Attack Damage on the trail.
entries.spell_nocturner_summary: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.
entries.spell_nocturner_tooltip: Nocturne darkens the map, reducing the sight radius of all enemy champions and removing their vision of allies for @ParanoiaDuration@ seconds. Nocturne can <recast>Recast</recast> this Ability during the duration to launch himself at an enemy champion dealing <physicalDamage>@Damage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.
entries.spell_nocturner_tooltipsimple:
Enemies cannot see what other enemies see for @ParanoiaDuration@ second(s).

Re-activate during this to dash to and damage an enemy champion.
entries.spell_nocturneshroudofdarkness_tooltipex: <rules>This Ability will remain active during <spellName>Paranoia's</spellName> flight.</rules>
entries.spell_nocturnew_summary: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.
entries.spell_nocturnew_tooltip:
Passive: Nocturne gains @ActiveAS@% Attack Speed.

Active: Nocturne creates a shadow barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability. If an Ability is blocked, this Ability's passive effect is increased to @ActiveAS*2@% Attack Speed for @DoubleASDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_nocturnew_tooltipsimple:
Passive: Nocturne gains @ActiveAS@% Attack Speed.

Active: Block the next enemy ability that hits him within 1.5 second(s).
entries.spell_overdrive_summary: Blitzcrank super charges themself to get dramatically increased Move and Attack Speed. They are temporarily slowed after the effect ends.
entries.spell_overdrive_tooltip:
Blitzcrank supercharges themself, gaining @MoveSpeedMod*100@% decaying Move Speed and @AttackSpeedMod*100@% Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds.

Afterwards, Blitzcrank is Slowed by @MoveSpeedModReduction*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_phosphorusbomb_summary: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration.
entries.spell_phosphorusbomb_tooltip: Corki lobs a bomb, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. The area and champions hit are revealed for @RevealDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_powerfist_summary: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make the next attack deal double damage and pop their target up in the air.
entries.spell_powerfist_tooltip: Blitzcrank charges up their fist, causing their next Attack to <status>Knock Up</status> for @CCDuration@ second(s) and deal <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.
entries.spell_pulverize_summary: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air.
entries.spell_pulverize_tooltip: Alistar smashes the ground, <status>Knocking Up</status> enemies for @KnockupDuration@ second and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_rapidreload_summary: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus <trueDamage>true damage</trueDamage>.
entries.spell_rapidreload_tooltip:
Corki's Attacks and Spellblades deal @AttackConversion*100@% bonus true damage.
Attacks: @BasicAttackTOOLTIP@.
Critical Strikes: @CriticalStrikeTOOLTIP@.
entries.spell_relle_summary:
Passive: Rell gains out of combat Move Speed.

Active: Rell and an ally gain ramping Move Speed, doubled toward enemies and each other. Her next Attack explodes, dealing magic damage.
entries.spell_relle_tooltip: Rell and an ally charge, gaining <speed>@MinMS*100@% Move Speed</speed>, increased to <speed>@MaxMS*100@%</speed> when facing enemy champions or each other for @Duration@ seconds. Rell's next Attack or <spellName>{{Spell_RellQ_Name}}</spellName> explodes in an area for <magicDamage>@MaxHealthDamageCalc@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_relle_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Damage capped at @PercentHealthDamageCap@ against jungle monsters and structures.</rules>
entries.spell_rellp_summary: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.
entries.spell_rellp_tooltip: Rell's Attacks and Abilities steal <scaleArmor>@StealPercent*100@% Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>@StealPercent*100@% Magic Resist</scaleMR> for @ShredDuration@ seconds. Max: @MaxPercentTooltipOnly@%. Basic attacks deal <magicDamage>@OnHitDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> on-hit.
entries.spell_rellp_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_RellP_Tooltip}}

Always steals at least @StealFloor@. Does not steal from minions or Epic jungle monsters.
entries.spell_rellq_summary: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.
entries.spell_rellq_tooltip: Rell thrusts her lance, <status>Stunning</status> targets for @StunDuration@ seconds, destroying all <shield>Shields</shield>, and dealing <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage.</magicDamage>
entries.spell_rellr_summary: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.
entries.spell_rellr_tooltip: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently <status>Pulling</status> nearby enemies towards herself. Then Rell constantly <status>Drags</status> nearby enemies towards herself and deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over the next @Duration@ seconds.
entries.spell_rellw_dismount_summary:
Mounted: Rell Dismounts, crashing down in her armor, Knocking enemies up and gaining a large Shield. While dismounted, she gains Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range, but is Slowed.

Dismounted: Rell forms her Mount, gaining a burst of speed and Knocking Up the next enemy she attacks.
entries.spell_rellw_dismount_tooltip:
Passive - Mounted Alacrity: Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountedMoveSpeed@ Move Speed while mounted.

Active - {{Spell_RellW_Dismount_Name}}: Rell leaps off her mount, Knocking Up enemies and dealing @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountDamage@ magic damage. Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:Shield@ Shield, which lasts until she remounts.

Rell then enters her armored form, gaining @spell.RellW_Dismount:ResistanceIncrease*100@% increased Armor and Magic Resist, @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedASBoost*100@% Attack Speed and @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedRangeBoost@ Attack Range. In this armored form, she can use {{Spell_RellW_MountUp_Name2}}.
entries.spell_rellw_dismount_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_RellW_Dismount_Tooltip}}

Active - {{Spell_RellW_MountUp_Name2}}: Rell mounts up and briefly gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountUpSpeed*100@% Decaying Move Speed. Her next Attack within @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountUpSpeedDuration@ seconds Knocks Up and throws enemies behind her, dealing an additional @spell.RellW_Dismount:FlipDamage@ magic damage.
entries.spell_rellw_mountup_tooltip2:
Passive - Dismounted Resilience: Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:ResistanceIncrease*100@% increased Armor and Magic Resist, @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedASBoost*100@% Attack Speed and @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedRangeBoost@ Attack Range while dismounted.

Active - {{Spell_RellW_MountUp_Name2}}: Rell mounts up and briefly gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountUpSpeed*100@% Decaying Move Speed. Her next Attack within @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountUpSpeedDuration@ seconds Knocks Up and throws enemies behind her, dealing an additional @spell.RellW_Dismount:FlipDamage@ magic damage.

Rell then enters her mounted form, gaining @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountedMoveSpeed@ Move Speed. While mounted, Rell can use {{Spell_RellW_Dismount_Name}}.
entries.spell_rellw_mountup_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_RellW_MountUp_Tooltip2}}

Active - {{Spell_RellW_Dismount_Name}}: Rell leaps off her mount, Knocking Up enemies and dealing @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountDamage@ magic damage. Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:Shield@ Shield, which lasts until she remounts.
entries.spell_rocketgrab_summary: Blitzcrank fires their right hand to grab an opponent on its path, dealing damage and dragging it back to them.
entries.spell_rocketgrab_tooltip: Blitzcrank fires their right hand, <status>Pulling</status> the first enemy hit towards them and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_sivire_summary: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.
entries.spell_sivire_tooltip: Sivir creates a magical barrier for @SpellShieldDuration@ seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores <healing>@TotalHeal@ health</healing> and triggers Fleet of Foot.
entries.spell_sivire_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>This shield blocks both champion and item Abilities.</rules>
entries.spell_sivirpassive_summary: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.
entries.spell_sivirpassive_tooltip: Sivir's Attacks and Abilities grant her a burst of @FlatMS@ Decaying Move Speed for @HasteDuration@ seconds when they damage enemy champions.
entries.spell_sivirq_summary: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.
entries.spell_sivirq_tooltip: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@</physicalDamage> to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of @FallOffMinimum*100@%.
entries.spell_sivirq_tooltipextendedbelowline:
The damage falloff resets upon beginning its return.
Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at @CritRatio*100@% effectiveness.
Cast time scales down with Attack Speed
entries.spell_sivirr_summary: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.
entries.spell_sivirr_tooltip:
Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them @MaxMS*100@% Move Speed for @UltDuration@ seconds.

Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by @AttackCooldownRefund@ seconds.

Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.
entries.spell_sivirw_summary: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.
entries.spell_sivirw_tooltip:
For the next @BuffDuration@ seconds, Sivir gains @RicochetAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing @BounceDamage@ physical damage each bounce for up to @MaxBounces@ bounces.

These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does.
entries.spell_sivirw_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Bounces will prioritize new targets before returning to targets that have already been struck. Can only hit each target a maximum of two times.
Bounces deal @MinionDamageMod*100@% damage to minions.
This ability executes low Health minions.
entries.spell_staticfield_summary: Enemies attacked by Blitzcrank are marked and take lightning damage after 1 second. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to remove nearby enemies' shields, damage them, and silence them briefly.
entries.spell_staticfield_tooltip:
Passive: While this ability is available, lightning charges Blitzcrank's fists, marking those Attacked. After 1 second, they are shocked for @PassiveDamage@ magic damage.

Active: Blitzcrank overcharges, dealing @ActiveDamage@ magic damage and Silencing nearby enemies for @SilenceDuration@ seconds. Their shields are also destroyed.
entries.spell_syndrae_summary: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.
entries.spell_syndrae_tooltip:
Syndra projects a wave of force, Knocking Back enemies and Dark Spheres and dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Dark Spheres that are pushed Stun enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds and deal @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

@spell.SyndraPassive:EUpgradeThreshold@ Splinters of Wrath: This Ability's width is increased and Slows enemies by @UpgradedSlowAmount*100@% for @UpgradedSlowDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_syndrae_tooltipextendedbelowline: Enemies can only take damage and be Knocked Back from this Ability once per cast.
entries.spell_syndrapassive_summary:
Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.

Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge
Force of Will: Bonus true damage.
Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets
Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets
entries.spell_syndrapassive_tooltip:
Syndra can collect up to @MaxStackAmount@ Splinters of Wrath. These enhance Syndra's Abilities and restore @ManaPerProc@ Mana each time she claims one from an enemy.

Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from the following:
  • @StacksPerProc@ Splinter(s) when damaging enemy champions with two Abilities within @MarkDuration@ seconds (@PassiveMarkCooldown@s Cooldown)
  • @PassiveStacksPerLevel@ Splinters upon spending Ability points
  • @StackPerSiege@ Splinter on killing large minions

    At @MaxStackAmount@ Splinters of Wrath, Syndra increases her Ability Power by @CapstoneAPPerc*100@%.
entries.spell_syndraq_summary: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.
entries.spell_syndraq_tooltip:
Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere, dealing {{Spell_SyndraQ_Damage_0}}. The Dark Sphere remains for @SphereDuration@ seconds and can be manipulated by Syndra's other Abilities.

@spell.SyndraPassive:Q1UpgradeThreshold@ Splinters of Wrath: Syndra can store @Upgrade1MaxAmmo@ charges of Dark Sphere.
entries.spell_syndraq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>This Ability can be cast while moving.</rules>
entries.spell_syndraqupgrade_tooltip:
Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere, dealing {{Spell_SyndraQ_Damage_0}}. The Sphere remains for @spell.SyndraQ:SphereDuration@ seconds and can be manipulated by Syndra's other Abilities.

@spell.SyndraPassive:Q1UpgradeThreshold@ Splinters of Wrath: Syndra can store @Upgrade1MaxAmmo@ charges of Dark Sphere.

Syndra generates a Dark Sphere charge every @AmmoRechargeTime@ seconds (reduced by Ability Haste).
entries.spell_syndrar_summary: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.
entries.spell_syndrar_tooltip:
Passive: Dark Sphere gains an additional @QHastePerRank@ Ability Haste for each rank of Unleashed Power.

Syndra draws on her full cataclysmic power, launching the 3 Dark Spheres orbiting her plus up to 4 more nearby at an enemy champion. Each Dark Sphere deals @DamageCalc@ magic damage (max @MaxDamageCalc@ magic damage).

@spell.SyndraPassive:RUpgradeThreshold@ Splinters of Wrath: This Ability executes enemies below @UpgradeExecuteThreshold*100@% Health.
entries.spell_syndraw_summary: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.
entries.spell_syndraw_tooltip:
Syndra grabs a Dark Sphere, enemy minion, or non-epic monster. She drags it with her and can Recast for up to 5 seconds.

Recast: Syndra hurls the object, dealing {{Spell_SyndraW_Damage@f3@}} and Slowing by @TotalSlowAmount@% for @f2@ seconds.

@spell.SyndraPassive:WUpgradeThreshold@ Splinters of Wrath: This Ability deals an additional @TOOLTIPONLYPassiveBonusPercent@ true damage.
entries.spell_syndraw_tooltipextendedbelowline:
If no target is selected, grabs nearest Dark Sphere.
This Ability can be cast while moving.
entries.spell_tarice_summary: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.
entries.spell_tarice_tooltip: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after @ChargeDuration@ second to deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stun</status> enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_taricpassive_summary: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.
entries.spell_taricpassive_tooltip: After using an Ability, Taric's next 2 Attacks within @Duration@ seconds gain <attackSpeed>100% Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, deal an additional <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, and reduce his basic Ability Cooldowns by @CDR@ second.
entries.spell_taricq_summary: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.
entries.spell_taricq_tooltip:
Passive: Gain a stack (max @MaxCharges@) every @StackCooldown@ seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack.

Active: Consume all stacks to restore @HealingPerStack@ Health per stack to nearby ally champions (@MaxStackHealing@ at @MaxCharges@ stacks).
entries.spell_taricr_summary: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.
entries.spell_taricr_tooltip: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After @InitialDelay@ seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for @InvulnDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_taricw_summary:
Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.

Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.
entries.spell_taricw_tooltip:
Passive: Taric gains @BonusArmor@ Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains @BonusArmor@ Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally.

Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a @ShieldHPRatio@% max Health Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_taricw_tooltipextended:
Mimicked spell effects do not stack.
Only one ally can be bound at a time.
entries.spell_tryndameree_summary: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.
entries.spell_tryndameree_tooltip:
Tryndamere spins through his enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and generating @NonChampFuryGain@ Fury per enemy hit, increased to @ChampFuryGain@ Fury against enemy champions.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by @NonChampCDRefund@ seconds when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by @ChampCDRefund@ seconds when critically striking a champion.
entries.spell_tryndamerepassive_tooltip:
Tryndamere's Attacks grant him 5 Fury or 10 Fury for a critical strike, and 10 Fury for killing a unit. After 8 seconds of being out of combat, Tryndamere loses 5 Fury every second.

Each point of Fury grants @PassiveCritConversionTooltip@% Critical Strike Chance.
entries.spell_tryndamereq_summary: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.
entries.spell_tryndamereq_tooltip:
Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining up to @MaximumBonusAD@ Attack Damage based on his missing Health.

Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury, restoring @BaseHeal@ plus @HealPerFury@ Health per Fury (max: @MaximumHeal@).
entries.spell_tryndamereq_tooltipextendedbelowli: <rules>Maximum Attack Damage gained at @RemainingHealthThreshold*100@% remaining Health.</rules>
entries.spell_tryndamerew_summary: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.
entries.spell_tryndamerew_tooltip: Tryndamere hurls insults, reducing champions' Attack Damage by @ADReduction*-1@ for @ReductionDuration@ seconds and <status>Slowing</status> by @SlowPotency*-100@% while cowering from him for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_undyingrage_summary: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.
entries.spell_undyingrage_tooltip: Tryndamere becomes completely immune to death for @TryndRDuration@ seconds, refusing to be reduced below @TryndRMinHealth@ Health, and instantly gains <keywordMajor>@TryndRFuryGain@ Fury</keywordMajor>.
entries.spell_veigarbalefulstrike_summary: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.
entries.spell_veigarbalefulstrike_tooltip:
Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacksLarge@ stacks instead.
entries.spell_veigardarkmatter_summary: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.
entries.spell_veigardarkmatter_tooltip:
Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Every @Spell.VeigarPassive:PStacksPerDarkMatterCDR@ stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @Spell.VeigarPassive:DarkMatterCDRIncrement*100@%.
entries.spell_veigareventhorizon_summary: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.
entries.spell_veigareventhorizon_tooltip: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that <status>Stuns</status> enemies that pass through for @StunDuration@ seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.
entries.spell_veigarpassive_summary: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.
entries.spell_veigarpassive_tooltip:
Veigar's Abilities grant him @dAbilityStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil when they strike enemy champions. Takedowns on champions grant an additional @dTakedownStacks@ stacks.

Each stack of Phenomenal Evil grants Veigar @APPerStack@ Ability Power.
entries.spell_veigarpassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_VeigarPassive_Tooltip}}

Veigar's evil is currently granting him @f1@ Ability Power
entries.spell_veigarr_summary: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.
entries.spell_veigarr_tooltip: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between <magicDamage>@MinDamage@ and @MaxDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.
entries.spell_viegoe_summary: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.
entries.spell_viegoe_tooltip: Viego sends forth a spectre to haunt the first terrain hit, surrounding it with Mist for @MistDuration@ seconds. Viego gains <keywordStealth>Camouflage</keywordStealth>, <speed>@TotalMoveSpeed@ Move Speed</speed>, and <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> while inside the Mist.
entries.spell_viegoe_tooltipextendedbelowline:
{{Reminder_Camouflage}}
Viego reveals himself for @RestealthTime@ seconds whenever he attacks or uses an Ability.
entries.spell_viegopassive_summary: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.
entries.spell_viegopassive_tooltip: The souls of enemy champions that die within @TakedownWindow@ seconds of being hit by Viego become wraiths. Viego can Attack wraiths to <keywordMajor>Possess</keywordMajor> them, restoring <healing>@PercentHealthHeal@% of enemy's max Health</healing> and gaining access to their non-ultimate Abilities, Attacks, and items for @TransformDuration@ seconds. During this time he replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own and gains <speed>@MoveSpeedPercent*100@% Move Speed</speed> towards enemy champions.
entries.spell_viegopassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_ViegoPassive_Tooltip}}

Viego keeps his summoner spells, runes, and trinkets during Possession and cannot use active or consumable items. Passive item Cooldowns are shared across Possessions.
entries.spell_viegoq_summary:
Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health.

Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.
entries.spell_viegoq_tooltip:
Passive: Viego's Attacks deal an additional @TotalPercentHealthOnHit@ current Health physical damage. His first Attack against an enemy he has recently damaged with an Ability hits a second time, dealing @SecondAttackDamage@ physical damage and restoring @HealModVsChamps*100@% of damage dealt as Health. These bonuses are kept during Possession.

Active: Viego stabs forward, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage.
entries.spell_viegoq_tooltipextendedbelowline:
The second strike can Critically Strike and applies %i:OnHit% On-Hit effects while not Possessing an enemy. Its healing is decreased to @HealModVsMonsters*100@% vs. jungle monsters and @HealModVsMinions*100@% vs. minions.
The bonus %i:OnHit% On-Hit damage can critically strike for @HealthCritDamage@ current Health and deals a minimum of @MinDamageOnHit@ damage. It deals a max of @MonsterCapOnHit@ damage vs. jungle monsters.
This Ability's cast time is reduced with Attack Speed. Its damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Damage at @ActiveCritMod*100@% effectiveness.
entries.spell_viegor_summary: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.
entries.spell_viegor_tooltip: Viego discards any souls he is currently <keywordMajor>Possessing</keywordMajor> and teleports. On arrival he Attacks the champion with the lowest percent Health, briefly <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowPercent*100@% and dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ + @TotalPercentHealth@% missing Health physical damage</physicalDamage>. Other nearby enemies are <status>Knocked Back</status> and take <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.
entries.spell_viegor_tooltipextendedbelowline:
This Ability applies on-hit effects to the primary target and spell effects to everything else.
Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Damage at @CritMod*100@% effectiveness.
entries.spell_viegow_summary: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.
entries.spell_viegow_tooltip:
Begin Charging: Viego begins gathering Mist, Slowing himself by @SelfSlowPercent*100@%.

Release: Viego dashes forward and hurls the gathered Mist. Deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Stuns the first enemy hit for @Stunduration@ to @MaxStunTT@ seconds based on charge time.
entries.spell_viegow_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>This Ability's Cooldown is set to @CDWheninterrupted@ seconds when interrupted.</rules>
entries.spell_volibeare_summary: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.
entries.spell_volibeare_tooltip:
Volibear summons a thundercloud that fires a lightning bolt, dealing @TotalDamageTooltip@ plus @PercentDamage*100@% max Health magic damage and Slowing by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

If Volibear is inside the blast zone, he gains a @ShieldAPRatioTooltip@ plus @ShieldAmount*100@% max Health Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_volibearp_summary: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.
entries.spell_volibearp_tooltip:
Volibear gains @AttackSpeedCalc@ Attack Speed for @BuffDuration@ seconds whenever he deals damage with an Ability or Attack, stacking up to 5 times.

At 5 stacks, Volibear's claws ignite with lightning, causing his Attacks to deal an additional @ChainLightningDamage@ magic damage to the target and 4 closest enemies.
entries.spell_volibearq_summary: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, <status>Stunning</status> and damaging the first one he Attacks.
entries.spell_volibearq_tooltip:
Volibear gains @MinSpeedCalc@ Move Speed, doubled to @MaxSpeedCalc@ towards enemy champions for the next @Duration@ seconds. While active, Volibear's next Attack deals @CalculatedDamage@ physical damage and Stuns the target for @StunDuration@ second.

Volibear becomes enraged if an enemy Immobilizes him before he Stuns a target, ending the Ability early but refreshing its Cooldown.
entries.spell_volibearq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Volibear gains @BonusRange@ attack range for this attack.</rules>
entries.spell_volibearr_summary: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health.  Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.
entries.spell_volibearr_tooltip:
Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining @HealthAmount@ Health and @BonusAttackRange@ Attack Range for the next @TransformDuration@ seconds.

Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, Disabling nearby towers for @TowerDisableDuration@ seconds and dealing @TowerDamageTooltip@ physical damage to them. Nearby enemies are Slowed by @SlowAmount*100@%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffer @SweetSpotDamageTooltip@ physical damage.
entries.spell_volibearw_summary: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them.  Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.
entries.spell_volibearw_tooltip:
Volibear mauls an enemy, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and marking them for @MarkDuration@ seconds.

If this Ability is used on a marked target, its damage is increased to @EmpoweredDamage@ and Volibear restores @BaseHeal@ plus @PercentMissingHealthHealingRatio@ missing Health.
entries.spell_volibearw_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Empowered damage scales with %i:scaleAD% (Damage multiplier: @W2DamageMultiplier*100@% + @W2BonusADDamageMultiplier*10000@%)
This Ability applies on-hit effects.
Healing is @MinionAndMonsterMod*100@% effective against minions.
entries.spell_wujustyle_summary: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.
entries.spell_wujustyle_tooltip: Master Yi's Attacks deal an additional <trueDamage>@TotalDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> for @Duration@ seconds.
entries.spell_wujustyle_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>The duration of <spellName>{{ Spell_WujuStyle_Name }}</spellName> is paused during <spellName>{{ Spell_AlphaStrike_Name }}</spellName> and <spellName>{{ Spell_Meditate_Name }}</spellName></rules>
entries.spell_wujustyle_tooltipsimple: Basic attacks deal bonus damage for @Duration@ seconds.
entries.spell_yuumihugcast_summary: Yuumi dashes to a target ally, becoming untargetable from everything except turrets. While on her Best Friend, she gains Heal & Shield Power and grants her Ally On-Hit healing.
entries.spell_yuumihugcast_tooltip:
Passive: While on her Best Friend, Yuumi gains an additional @HealAndShieldPower*100@% Heal & Shield Power and her ally also restores @HealthOnHit@ health On-Hit %i:OnHit%.

Active: Yuumi dashes to an ally champion and Attaches to them. While Yuumi is Attached, she follows her partner's movement and is Untargetable except from towers.

Immobilizing effects on Yuumi place this Ability on a @CCAttachLockout@ second Cooldown.
entries.spell_yuumimagicmissile_summary:
Yuumi fires a missile, dealing damage and slowing first target hit. It deals bonus damage and an enchanced slow if it takes at least 1.35 seconds to get to its target. While on her Best Friend, the slow is always enhanced and grants bonus On-Hit damage to her ally.

While Attached, the missile can be controlled with your cursor for a brief period.
entries.spell_yuumimagicmissile_tooltip:
Yuumi summons an errant missile that deals @TotalMissileDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy and Slows the target for @SlowAmount@%.

If cast while Attached, Yuumi can control the missile using her mouse for a short period before it accelerates in a straight line. The accelerated missile deals @TotalMissileDamageEmpowered@ magic damage and Slows the target for @EmpoweredSlowAmount@% for @EmpoweredSlowDuration@ seconds, instead.

Best Friend Bonus: Prowling Projectile's Slow will always be enhanced and hitting an enemy champion also grants them @OnHitDamageCalc@ magic damage On-Hit %i:OnHit% for @BuffDuration@ seconds.

The bonus On-Hit damage can be increased by @AllyCritChanceMaxAmp*100@% based her ally's Critical Strike Chance.
entries.spell_yuumipassive_summary:
Periodically, when Yuumi strikes a champion with an attack or ability, she restores health to herself and the next ally she Attaches to.

While Attached, Yuumi generates a special bond with her allies. The ally with the strongest bond enhances Yuumi's abilities while she is Attached to them.
entries.spell_yuumipassive_tooltip:
When Yuumi's Attacks and Abilities strike champions, she heals herself for @HealAmount@ health. If Yuumi Attaches to an ally within @HealDelayTime@ seconds, they are healed as well. This effect has a @PassiveCooldown@ second Cooldown.

While Attached, Yuumi gains Friendship with her ally whenever they kill a champion or minion. The ally with the most Friendship becomes her Best Friend and grants Yuumi bonus effects to her Abilities while she is Attached to them.

The heal will automatically trigger if Yuumi is already Attached to an ally.
entries.spell_yuumiqrelease_tooltip: Reactivate this spell to have the missile continue in current direction.
entries.spell_yuumir_summary: Yuumi channels five waves that damage enemies and heal allies. Yuumi can move, attach, and cast Zoomies! while channeling. While on her Best Friend, this spell also follows her mouse.
entries.spell_yuumir_tooltip:
Yuumi channels for @UltDuration@ seconds, launching @NumberOfWaves@ magical waves affecting both teams. If initially cast while Attached, Yuumi can steer the waves to follow her mouse.

Enemies struck are dealt @TotalMissileDamage@ magic damage and Slowed by @BaseSlow*-100@% for @CCDuration@ seconds, increased by @BonusSlowPerWave*-100@% per wave hit.

Ally champions are healed for @TotalHealPerWave@ health per wave. Excess healing is converted to a Shield instead.

Best Friend Bonus: For her Best Friend, the heal is increased to @EnhancedHealPerWave@ health.

Casting You and Me! will locks the waves in the current direction.
Yuumi can move and cast Zoomies while channeling.
entries.spell_yuumir_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Missiles after the first deal <magicDamage>@MultiMissileTotal@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Max possible damage to a single enemy is <magicDamage>@TotalSingleTargetDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.</rules>
entries.spell_yuumispellshield_summary: Shields Yuumi and boosts Move Speed and Attack Speed. If she's attached, she passes it to her ally instead.
entries.spell_yuumispellshield_tooltip:
Yuumi shields herself, blocking @TotalShielding@ damage and gains @TotalAttackSpeed@% Attack Speed for @MSDuration@ seconds. While the shield persists, the target also gains @MSAmount@% Move Speed.

If Yuumi is Attached, this Ability affects her ally instead and also restores @ManaRestore@ Mana to them, increased by up to @MaxManaPercIncrease*100@% based on the target's missing Mana.
entries.spell_yuumiw_tooltipextendedbelowline:
This Ability has a @spell.YuumiW:AttachCooldown@ second Cooldown, but Yuumi can cast it anytime she is already Attached to switch between friends or Unattach.

Yuumi's Abilities will use her Attached ally's position instead of hers.

Yuumi will Unattach if her ally uses Summoner Teleport.
entries.spell_yuumiwend_summary: Yuumi can reactivate this spell to dash to another ally champion, or to detach from her current ally.
entries.spell_yuumiwend_tooltip:
Passive: While on her Best Friend, Yuumi is increasing her Heal & Shield Power by @spell.YuumiW:HealAndShieldPower*100@%.

Her Best Friend also gains @spell.YuumiW:HealthOnHit@ healing On-Hit.

Active: Yuumi dashes to another ally champion, or detaches from her current friend.
